# Decisions

What is settled, what is still open, and who decides. Update this file when a decision lands, and record the date.

## Settled

| Date | Decision |
|---|---|
| 27 Oct 2026 | Keep the existing navy (`ink`, #0A0F1C) and Doefin Blue (#3475FE). One accent per screen. Flat colour: the blue-to-purple gradient and the glows are retired. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Orange (#F05122) means loss or error only, never decoration. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Buttons use #2C63D8, because white text on #3475FE is only 4.1:1. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | A light theme exists for documents, decks and print. Dark is the default everywhere else. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Describe Doefin in plain words ("Markets for Bitcoin mining difficulty."). Don't use "hashrate derivatives" or "prediction market" in new copy. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Doefin is registered in Port Louis, Mauritius. It is never described as a UK company. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Manrope is the only typeface. |
| 27 Oct 2026 | The writing follows Matteo's own voice (`voice.md`, `voice-samples.md`). |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Raffaella Tenconi is not part of Doefin. Older team documents and the old site name this person as regulatory adviser and approver by mistake. Never name them as part of the team or as an approver. |
